title: Trade Marketing Manager
description:
Trade Marketing Manager Retail Competitive Salary

We are partnering with an established consumer brand to recruit a Trade Marketing Manager to lead the planning and delivery of campaigns across its wholesale and retail network.

This is a commercially focused marketing role, working across brand, retail, wholesale and digital channels to bring campaigns, product launches and seasonal activity to life. The Trade Marketing Manager will play an important role in strengthening retail presence, supporting wholesale partners and ensuring customers experience a consistent and engaging brand proposition across every touchpoint.

The role would suit a creative and commercially minded marketer who understands how brands operate in a retail environment and can take campaigns from strategy and planning through to execution and measurement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver trade marketing plans aligned to wider brand and commercial objectives.
- Lead integrated campaigns across wholesale, retail and digital channels, from initial concept through to execution.
- Work closely with wholesale partners to develop effective retail marketing activity that drives visibility, engagement and sales.
- Plan and deliver seasonal campaigns, product launches and key commercial initiatives.
- Develop and manage retail marketing assets including POS, in-store displays, promotional materials and digital content.
- Partner with internal teams across Brand, Ecommerce, Sales and Product to ensure campaigns are aligned and delivered effectively.
- Support the development of customer-facing content across social media, email and other digital channels.
- Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify opportunities and inform campaign planning.
- Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agencies and external partners where required.
- Monitor campaign performance and commercial results, using data and insight to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Ensure all trade marketing activity is delivered consistently and in line with brand guidelines.
- Keep up to date with retail, consumer and marketing trends to identify new opportunities for the brand and its retail partners.

Key Requirements
- Proven experience in trade marketing, retail marketing or a closely related consumer marketing role.
- Experience working within a retail, consumer, wholesale or D2 C environment.
- Strong understanding of the retail customer journey and how marketing activity can influence awareness, engagement and sales.
- Experience delivering integrated campaigns across physical and digital channels.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercially aware, with confidence using campaign and sales data to assess performance and make recommendations.
- Experience working with wholesale partners, retailers, agencies or external stakeholders would be beneficial.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including social media, email and online content.
- Creative thinker who can develop ideas but is equally comfortable managing the detail required to deliver them.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
- A degree in Marketing, Business or a related discipline would be beneficial, although relevant industry experience will be equally valued.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced Trade Marketing Manager to take ownership of a broad retail marketing remit, working across campaigns, launches, wholesale partnerships and customer engagement within an established consumer business.

If you are a commercially minded Trade Marketing Manager who enjoys combining creative campaign development with hands-on delivery and measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant Manager
description:
What Sets Us Apart

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. Were ranked as number 11 in the UK s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world's 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.

Our people-centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose-led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

We invest in our colleagues because they are the foundation of our shared success. With access to resources and award-winning development programmes, you will have the space to shape your career while making a real impact.

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.

Here, You'll Go Beyond Numbers

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant Manager who thrives on variety, enjoys a fast-moving environment, and wants their work to make a real difference

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Marketing will go beyond the numbers, it's about building trusted relationships, understanding their requirements, navigating risks, and delivering insights that support informed decision-making.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a position within the Digital Marketing team, reporting into the Senior Digital Marketing Manager. You will line manage junior members of the team, whilst helping to lead delivery across our four brands and their markets: MHA UK, Baker Tilly Ireland, Baker Tilly South East Europe and MHA UAE.

Leadership & people
- Support and develop junior members of the digital marketing team, holding regular one-to-ones and owning their appraisals and development.
- Review work and provide timely, constructive feedback.
- Plan and allocate work with the Senior Digital Marketing Manager to help set workflows and tasks across the team so the right people are on the right tasks, keeping deadlines realistic and workloads manageable.
- Coach and build capability in others, setting the standard in the team by how you operate.

Campaigns & projects
- Oversee digital campaigns from concept through to delivery across multiple channels and markets, keeping brand messaging consistent and correctly targeted.
- Own digital projects from start to finish, coordinating internal and external resource, and taking accountability for delivery.
- Take ownership of a specialist digital area within the digital function, leading its plan and answering for its results.
- Join up delivery with other specialists teams, such as creative and comms.

Channels & digital operations
- Support on day-to-day delivery across the full digital mix: the brand websites, organic and paid social, paid search, email, content and UX.
- Keeping lead trackers and digital documentation accurate and making sure digital practice stays on brand and compliant with GDPR.
- Resolve and support on day-to-day issues, knowing when to escalate where a decision needs to sit above you.

Performance, Analytics and Reporting
- Analyse large data sets and translate findings into clear commercial insights and actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the firm.
- Use performance data to optimise campaigns, demonstrating ROI and year-on-year improvement against key metrics.
- Take ownership of regular reporting within your area, supporting monthly and quarterly updates for the Senior Digital Marketing Manager and Partners.

Growth and Commercial Impact
- Play a key role in campaign planning for priority sectors and service lines, identifying opportunities to maximise digital performance and commercial outcomes.
- Support business development and lead generation through digital channels, improving both the volume and quality of inbound enquiries.
- Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their objectives to deliver effective, results-driven campaigns.

Brand and Governance
- Act as a brand guardian across all digital activity, ensuring content consistently reflects the Baker Tilly brand values and messaging.
- Champion digital best practice, ensuring accessibility, compliance, and governance requirements are met.
- Contribute actively to internal marketing committees, helping to drive positive change and continuous improvement across the team.

What we are looking for
- An experienced digital marketing professional with a proven record of planning and delivering campaigns that achieve ROI.
- Well informed across the digital marketing mix, spanning web, organic and paid social, paid search and email, with the ability to adapt tone of voice for different markets and audiences.
- Experience of managing high-budget SEO and PPC campaigns, from keyword strategy and bid management through to performance tracking.
- Experience of improving customer journeys and conversion across websites, including CRO, landing page and form optimisation.
- The ability to develop and oversee complex campaigns from concept to execution.
- Some experience of line management, or the readiness and judgement to take it on and develop more junior colleagues.
- Strong commercial and analytical judgement, comfortable turning data into decisions.
- Confident with stakeholders and credible enough to influence at a senior level.
- Degree level or equivalent in a marketing or business related subject, or equivalent experience.
- A driving licence and access to a car.
- Familiarity with the digital marketing tool stack, including analytics, social management and paid media platforms.

title: Marketing Specialist - Paid Social & Content (Remote)
description:
What you'll do
- Plan, build and run paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Google and Apple Search Ads, through budget pacing to an honest weekly readout of what worked.
- Make the ad creative yourself. You won't be handing briefs to an agency and waiting a fortnight: you'll cut the video, write the hooks, build the variants and get them live while the idea is still worth testing. Our Content Creator is there for the bigger productions, but the day-to-day ad creative is yours.
- Own the organic social calendar across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and Reddit: plan it, write it, ship it, and keep HiiKER sounding like HiiKER.
- Test channels beyond the obvious ones, Reddit communities, hiking press and print, tourism boards, podcast sponsorships, outdoor retail partnerships, and be straight with us about which ones deserve more money and which don't.
- Manage engagement properly. Our audience talks back constantly, in comments, DMs and forum threads, and a fast, human reply is one of the best marketing assets we have.
- Continue to build upon our influencer and partnership pipeline, end to end: find them, pitch them, negotiate, brief them, and track what actually converts rather than what merely got views. Our Ambassador programme is already running and is yours to grow.
- Organise and co-host live webinars alongside Pete and Paul, our co-founders, choose the topics, line up guests, drive sign-ups, run the show on the day and handle the follow-up.
- Own App Store Optimisation across the App Store and Play Store: keywords, screenshots, listing copy, localisation and a steady cadence of A/B tests.
- Report on all of it. Analytics, Search Console and the store consoles, you'll be in them daily and you'll be the person who tells the rest of us what the numbers mean.

What we're looking for
- Two to four years running consumer marketing hands-on, ideally for an app or a subscription product. We care much more about what you've personally shipped than about the size of the company you shipped it at.
- You've owned a paid social budget yourself and can talk about CAC, ROAS and payback periods from your own campaigns, including the ones that didn't work.
- A strong, quick writer with a native feel for short-form video and for how each platform's audience actually talks.
- You can produce the creative yourself - cutting short-form video in CapCut or similar, and putting together static and carousel ads. It doesn't need to be broadcast quality; it needs to be quick, native to the platform and testable.
- Comfortable in analytics tools without needing someone to pull numbers for you. You should be able to build a funnel view and spot when a metric is lying.
- Genuinely self-directed. There is no marketing department to hide behind and nobody will be assigning you tasks each morning.

Bonus points for
- Previous ASO work, or experience growing a subscription app.
- You hike, run trails, or otherwise spend real time outdoors.
- Experience with community-heavy channels like Reddit or Discord, where marketing that smells like marketing gets punished.

About HiiKER HiiKER is a hiking app used by well over a million people to find trails, download offline maps and navigate everything from an afternoon loop to a thousand-kilometre thru-hike.

We're a remote team based across the UK and Ireland. The work you do shows up in the product within weeks, and nobody here has the luxury of only doing the parts of their job they enjoy.

What we offer
- Remote-first - work from wherever you're happiest, with occasional team meet-ups.
- A short path from "good idea" to "shipped" - no layers of sign-off.
- Real ownership of a channel or a system, not a slice of someone else's plan.
- Budget for the kit and tools you need to do the job properly.
- A free HiiKER PRO+ account for you, and a few to give away.
- Time and encouragement to actually get outdoors - it's the product, and we mean it.

The next step is a short intro call, one practical conversation about the work itself, and a final chat with Pete and Paul, the founders.

title: Senior Marketing Account Manager FTC
description:
Liverpool Experience Campus operates the city's waterfront event campus - the interconnected M&S Bank Arena, Convention Centre and Exhibition Centre as well as ticketing agency Ticket Quarter and the Pullman Liverpool Hotel. Playing a leading role in shining a spotlight on Liverpool, we have successfully staged a wide array of national and international events, from shows and conventions, business events to exhibitions, developing our offer over the last decade to that of a world-class provider of venue and event services.

We are currently looking for a Senior Marketing Account Manager to join our team on a 12-month plus FTC.

Company Benefits

We are an award-winning, world-class venue where our people are at the heart of everything that we do. Recognition and reward are of huge importance to us at Liverpool Experience Campus, and just some of the benefits staff can enjoy include:
- An enhanced holiday scheme which increases with length of service.
- An excellent pension scheme is available.
- Access to a premium health care policy, which includes an employee assistant line, contributions towards a wide range of medical costs, such as dental and optical and staff discounts.
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave schemes.
- An excellent occupational sick pay scheme.
- Free onsite parking right in the heart of the city centre.
- Employee Reward Platform.
- A dedicated wellbeing strategy to support staff when at work.
- 25 Qualified Mental Health First Aiders on site.

Liverpool Experience Campus is a place where you can truly make a difference. Some of the Liverpool Experience Campus's achievements include:
- Disability Confident Employer
- Sunflower Friendly Business
- Member of the Fair Employment Charter
- Real Living Wage employer
- Social value impact plan - last year we contributed over £6.4m
- Green Meeting's Gold Standard
- Sustainability Strategy
- Positively influencing biodiversity - In the grounds of our campus, we have 3 beehives
- Carbon Neutral Campus
- Accessibility Strategy
- AccessAble Guide

About the Role

As our Senior Marketing Account Manager, you'll drive the marketing strategy and delivery for a diverse portfolio of live entertainment, consumer and exhibition events across Liverpool Experience Campus venues. Acting as a trusted partner to event promoters and organisers, you'll develop creative, results-driven campaigns that drive ticket sales, visitor attendance and audience engagement.

Working across our world-class venues, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on campaign delivery, using market insights, digital marketing tools and performance data to maximise results. You'll also support a Junior Marketing Account Manager, helping to develop talent within the team while ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and within budget.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced marketing professional who thrives in a fast-paced events environment, enjoys building strong client relationships and is passionate about creating unforgettable live experiences.

If you are a hardworking and committed professional ready to contribute to our continued success, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us at Liverpool Experience Campus and be part of something extraordinary.

Please note, we may close this vacancy before the stated closing date if we receive sufficient applications for the position. Therefore, if you are interested in this position, please submit your application form as soon as possible. Role to commence from October 2026.

Closing Date: 04 October 2026

Interview Date: W/C 12 October 2026

Values

At Liverpool Experience Campus, our values shape every moment of how we work together. One Big Team means we collaborate, support each other and celebrate shared success. Take The Initiative empowers our people to be proactive and confident in making things happen. All Welcome reflects our commitment to inclusion, ensuring every colleague and visitor feels respected and valued, and with Every Moment Matters, we focus on delivering exceptional experiences - for our city and each other.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

Liverpool Experience Campus knows the value of having a diverse and representative team across our organisation. We promote equal opportunities and are committed to having an inclusive work force where everybody feels respected, are treated fairly and diversity is celebrated. As such we strongly encourage and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all members of the community regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, race, religion, belief or sexual orientation.
